title: Registration-Fee Carry for Multi-Pet Households — Community Rules & Site Care Training Q&A
content:
Under Community Rules & Site Care, a household with two or more registered pets may carry part of its registration-year pet fees dated within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date: 50% (one half) of those fees with at least 60 months of tenure, and 25% (one quarter) of them with fewer. A household with fewer than two registered pets carries none.

Tenure is counted in whole calendar months from the move-in date on the Home-Site Lease to the handling date; the registered pets are those counted on the plan record. The carry is subtracted from the past-due amount, and what remains once every amount allowed to stay on the statement has been subtracted is never less than zero.

## Questions and answers

**Which fees does the share apply to?** The registration-year pet fees on the statement dated within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date, for any of the household's pets.

**What does a household with one registered pet carry?** Nothing; the carry needs two or more registered pets.

**Where does the tenure threshold fall?** At 59 months the share is 25%; at 60 months it is 50%.

**Hypothetical worked case.** Two registered pets, with fees of $40.00 and $40.00 dated within the 12 months:

| Tenure | Share | Carry |
|---|---|---|
| 72 months | 50% | $40.00 |
| 30 months | 25% | $20.00 |

With fees of $35.00 and $35.00 and 30 months of tenure, the carry is 25% of $70.00, which is $17.50.
